title: Blank IBM Carbon kit
summary: An enterprise look: IBM Carbon Design System, dark theme, ready to build on.
ideas: Build an internal compliance dashboard with a data table and filters
Create a customer onboarding wizard with Carbon form components
Add notifications and a side navigation to this app
guide: Empty app using IBM Carbon ('@carbon/react', dark g100 theme, precompiled CSS, no Sass). Only src/App.jsx exists. No Tailwind in this pack: use Carbon components, inline styles or a small src/app.css. Import Carbon icons one at a time (e.g. import Add from '@carbon/icons-react/es/Add.js', PascalCase file name, then <Add size={16} />).
